issues: whether a series of transactions that technically comply with the Income Tax Act but whose only real effect is to eliminate tax constitute an avoidance transaction under s. 245(2)
whether obtaining a tax benefit was a principal purpose of the transactions under s. 245(1)
whether the transactions are abusive under s. 245(4) — the two-part abuse test
whether a reasonable expectation exists that the transactions would not be abusive under s. 245(4)(a)
whether the transactions were reasonable in all the circumstances under s. 245(4)(b)
what constitutes a tax benefit under s. 245(1)
whether a series of transactions should be considered as a whole or individually for GAAR purposes
key_facts: technical compliance with the Income Tax Act
only real effect was to eliminate tax
CRA invoked the general anti-avoidance rule
